dossier_meta.statement_text: Every non-null 6-regular graph has a $K_6$ minor.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors have found $K_6$-minor-free graphs with minimum degree six and maximum degree at most nine, and $K_6$-minor-free graphs with minimum degree five, maximum degree seven, and average degree arbitrarily close to $98/15$. Conjecture 1.3 asks whether 6-regularity alone forces a $K_6$ minor.
